title: unified-rollouts: proactive canary + shadow autorollback workflow
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve safety and observability for canary/A-B deployments by adding a proactive canary + shadow probing autorollback workflow. This workflow runs a staged canary with parallel shadow probing traffic, computes composite safety metrics (latency P95, error-rate, and quality regressions from the eval harness), and triggers an automated rollback if thresholds are violated. It addresses outage risk seen in recent incidents and reduces manual rollback overhead.

What changed: Implemented a coordinated controller that drives staged canary + shadow probes, adds a composite metric aggregator, and plugs into the existing autorollback engine. New config knobs for probing window, quorum, metric weights, and quarantine rules were added so platform owners can tune behavior per customer and per model.

Highlights: - New controller: rollout/probing_controller.py (goes through staged canary steps and triggers probing runs) - Autorollback engine integration: pkg/rollout/autorollback/engine.go (composite metric evaluation + safety guards) - Shadow balancer: services/traffic/shadow_balancer.go (adds sampling and probe multiplexing) - Observability: telemetry/metrics_rollouts.yaml and dashboards in redwood-console (P95 latency, probe success, metric quorum) - E2E tests: e2e/tests/rollout_probing_test.py covers staged probing, quarantine, and rollback paths - Docs: docs/unified-rollouts.md updated with workflow, knobs, and recommended thresholds

Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation and unit tests - [x] Autorollback composite metric evaluation - [x] Integration with shadow balancer - [x] Observability metrics and dashboards instrumentation - [x] E2E tests added and passing in CI - [x] Migration notes and rollout plan in docs

Testing and CI: CI initially failed on a flaky probe test; increased test timeout and added idempotency guards. CI now passes (integration + e2e). Tested in staging with a pinned model variant across a 3-hour soak: canary progression followed expected timing, shadow probes executed, and a synthetic regression correctly triggered the automated rollback path.

Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy rollout controller to staging, run canary for 24h with conservative thresholds, iterate with platform SRE. Default config is conservative (small canary weight, longer probing windows).

References: Linear ENG-2222 for feature spec, PM-3344 for product acceptance criteria, internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/unified-rollouts
